verdict.rationale: Extend's Parse output documents a `chunks` array with an accompanying `metadata` object, so parsed output is delivered pre-segmented rather than as a single blob. The pack gives no detail on how chunks are formed or whether they are tuned for embedding. The Splitting feature divides documents into sub-documents and is a separate capability, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented semantic-boundary chunking strategy, per-chunk metadata detail, embedding-ready sizing or configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG chunk quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, output comes pre-chunked for RAG — semantic boundaries, metadata, embedding-ready segments — not a wall of text

citations.quote: Parse runs now include a **`metadata`** object on `output`, alongside `chunks`
